g.title: ENERGY008_TOP_LEVEL
g.text: Route C working model | Rev 0.1-DRAFT | Design calculation flow, not a solved flowsheet

g.title: IN
g.text: Design basis + source assays + PFD/55 streams
Reaction network + property register + vendor maps

g.title: VAL
g.text: Approval state, source quality, design-case completeness
Reject nulls in required fields; retain non-required gaps

g.title: BLOCK
g.text: Return status, missing fields, source/owner and dependency
Do not default, zero-fill or silently extrapolate

g.title: PROP
g.text: Pure-component data + Shomate / IAPWS where valid
PR78 EOS + kij + phase stability + fugacity
Wilson/NRTL for MeOH-water only after regression
Store property status, validity and residuals

g.title: OUT
g.text: Solver logs, residual and closure reports

g.title: RXN
g.text: Stoichiometric matrix + exact rank + A·nu checks
Equilibrium only as a bound / consistency check

g.title: SEP
g.text: Track 55 streams and all utility interfaces

g.title: FAIL
g.text: Preserve last admissible iterate and diagnostics
Reduce relaxation / continuation only by logged rule
After limits: FAILED; suppress dependent exports

g.title: MB
g.text: Component + total mass + C/H/O element closure
No balancing stream; report residuals and uncertainty

g.title: EN
g.text: Consistent enthalpy datum and sign convention
Unit/plant energy closure; duties and utility loads

g.title: EX
g.text: Sgen diagnostic; physical exergy and Ed = T0 Sgen
Chemical exergy only with declared chemical dead state
Retain closure residuals; negative Sgen is not clipped

g.title: EQ
g.text: Compressor, exchanger, separator, column and storage checks
Electrical, cooling, steam, water, N2, instrument air
Emissions and wastewater boundary; sizing feasibility

g.title: ECON
g.text: Cost model only with sourced site/vendor inputs
Constrained optimisation only after feasible base case

g.title: KPI
g.text: GHG, economics and availability with correct boundary
Each KPI carries source, unit, status and uncertainty
